messages:
Anya K.: Kicking off a quick preflight thread for the webinar next week (Practical inference: demos, tradeoffs, and buyer signals). Need: final speaker order, a short run-of-show we can hand the producer, and a crisp fallback plan if live inference misbehaves.

Ben C.: I can cover the architecture + best-practices section. Can we keep the demo to 6 live examples rather than 12? less surface area to fail.

Marta (ops): Agree on 6. Ops will stage a dedicated demo machine, mirror the production routing, and prewarm caches. Fallback options I propose: 1) hot-switch to rwd-6b-quant; 2) enable canned responses for top 5 prompts; 3) cut to 90s recorded clip. Ill automate steps 1-2 on a health-trigger.

Devon (growth): For lead routing, let's add a quick 1-question registration form: "Primary goal with inference: prototyping / product / compliance." That will map to three nurture paths. Also propose adding an optional checkbox "Book a pilot" that flags AE.

Anya K.: Nice. Proposed run-of-show (35m + 10m Q):
- 0:00-0:03 host welcome + logistics (Anya)
- 0:03-0:10 market framing (Devon)
- 0:10-0:18 architecture & ops (Ben)
- 0:18-0:26 demo (Ben)
- 0:26-0:30 cost & optimization checklist (Anya)
- 0:30-0:40 live Q&A + poll (all)

Ben C.: Can we flip cost checklist to 0:12-0:18 and demo afterward so the demo answers the checklist takeaways? Audience likes immediate examples.

Anya K.: Fine, updated. Also: keep demo examples ordered by increasing latency/cost so we show tradeoffs visually.

Marta (ops): AV & rehearsals: mic check 10m prior; demo machine ssh key + demo user; healthcheck script running on 30s interval during show; private stage channel created for ops+speakers. Rehearsal tomorrow 11:00 PDT full run. Confirm?

Ben C.: Confirmed for rehearsal.

Devon (growth): Confirmed. Also will prepare the 1-line registration question and two header variants for AB test.

registrations-bot: Draft registration created: https://events.redwood.com/register/practical-inference. AB experiment flag: header_vA_vs_vB.

Anya K.: Demo details: primary model rwd-open-13b-q4 hosted; fallback to rwd-6b-quant. We'll also have a static CSV of canned outputs for the top 5 prompts (ops will host on CDN). Ben, please share the 6 demo prompts by EOD.

Ben C.: Shared in DM. Quick prewarm command for ops to run:
```bash
# prewarm cache for demo prompts
for p in $(cat demo_prompts.txt); do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-open-13b-q4","prompt":"'$p'"}' &\ndone
```
Marta (ops): Got it. I'll run prewarm tonight and upload the recorded fallback to gs://redwood-assets/wbnr/practical-inference-fallback.mp4. Also adding a 3-step runbook trigger: on 5xx > 4 in 30s OR p95 latency > 1.4s -> 1) auto-route demo to rwd-6b-quant, 2) enable CDN canned responses, 3) notify #release-war-room + stage-channel. We'll include a manual "cut to recorded" button too.

Devon (growth): Poll text for the Q&A: "Which best describes your team? (prototype, product, regulated)". Routing: prototype -> quickstart email, product -> playbook PDF + AE nurture, regulated -> AE + compliance pack. Also drafting the confirmation email blurb: "Live demo of tradeoffs + actionable checklist to reduce inference spend."

Anya K.: Speaker reminders: keep answers concise in Q&A; defer long infra asks to post-webinar follow-up doc. We'll collect deep-dive requests via a Confluence form.

Ben C.: One more: can ops expose a short health-check we can run on stage before demo starts? simple curl showing http_code and time.

Marta (ops): Yes, will add a one-liner healthcheck and a stage command that returns status.

Anya K.: Action items:
- demo prompts + script: Ben (due today)
- prewarm, recorded fallback, runbook: Marta (done tonight/tomorrow)
- registration question + AB headers: Devon (due today)
- final slide deck & speaker notes: Anya + Ben (due tomorrow)

Marta (ops): Private stage channel created and invites sent. Rehearsal reminder 11:00 PDT tomorrow.

Anya K.: Perfect. I'll post the final run-of-show after rehearsal and close the loop. Thanks everyone :tada:
